requirement.statement: All spl-bun depa ORM model fixtures and code-first consumers SHALL author relations only as typed Kunun navigation Properties with ORM metadata; scalar Fields, detached relation nodes, entity relationship sections and shadow code-first relation models SHALL NOT be accepted as canonical sources.

case.given: a source bundle declaring scalar Fields and typed owner or inverse Properties
case.when: the public depa ORM compiler builds the model
case.then: every navigable runtime relation SHALL trace to one declared Property and preserve its storage and runtime options

case.given: a programmatic Kunun ClassDefinition built with Field and Property members
case.when: the public definition compiler builds the model
case.then: the catalog SHALL be equivalent to the corresponding source model without rendering Kon or creating a detached relation graph

requirement.statement: The property-first migration SHALL preserve direct, inverse, one/many, composite, through, nested read/write, cascade, visibility, ordering and load-strategy behavior covered by the capsule suite.

case.given: all canonical fixtures have been migrated and dependencies resolve through public package exports
case.when: the complete capsule and host workspace gates run
case.then: the suites SHALL pass without compatibility readers, package deep imports or absolute workspace aliases

requirement.statement: Repository guards SHALL reject renewed canonical use of `:relationships=`, detached `(relation ...)`, `property_key`, `reverse_property_key`, retired `CodeFirstOrm*` relation authoring and unexported depa ORM package subpaths.

case.given: a canonical fixture, test helper, runtime consumer or copied DSL document reintroduces a retired authority marker
case.when: the package boundary and schema contract guards run
case.then: the build SHALL fail with a path and matched authority marker
